summary: Hardens the existing mirror restart lifecycle against a reproduced false-success state where a linked worktree lacks gitignored Web V2 build artifacts: Web-capable restarts now fail before stopping the current service when artifacts are missing/partial, and Web readiness requires both backend and /ui/v2 availability. The existing restart lifecycle remains the sole service-control authority.

components.owning_subsystem: mirror service restart lifecycle and mechanical Web readiness
components.disposition: ADMIT as a narrow fail-closed extension of the existing restart authority: validate Web V2 build artifacts before stopping a healthy Web and require the Web V2 route in addition to backend readiness after start. No build, rollback, model, or Agent semantic authority is added.
evidence: Production reproduced rc=0 and /auth/status=200 while /ui/v2 returned 404 because the exact linked code worktree lacked ignored webui/dist.
TDD RED locked missing artifact-preflight ordering and backend-only readiness before implementation.
Dynamic fixtures prove missing dist and partial dist with a missing hashed asset fail before restart side effects and persist an explicit failure receipt.
components.verification_level: TDD RED/GREEN, 24-test restart adjacency, bash syntax, whole-tree static/type/test CI, staged security, exact A.5 path coverage, and committed-state requalification
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: The program exposes only mechanical artifact existence/reference facts, HTTP readiness facts, logs, and restart receipts. It does not infer UI quality or task success. Missing artifacts fail before stop; post-start UI unavailability returns nonzero so the operator/model can inspect evidence and choose build/reuse/rollback explicitly.
components.rollback_route: Revert this restart-hardening commit. No persistent schema/data migration, provider change, Feishu protocol change, or 8901/model restart is involved.

g1.necessity: A restart mechanism that can stop a healthy Web and report success while the user-facing Web V2 route is absent creates a mechanical deployment-safety defect. Artifact completeness must therefore be checked before stop, and readiness must include the mounted UI route rather than backend health alone.

g2.authority_owner: existing scripts/restart_mirror.sh service lifecycle and readiness controller
g2.non_duplication: No second service controller or Web state machine is introduced. The change extends the existing restart preflight/readiness gates with artifact and HTTP facts and leaves build/rollback decisions explicit.

model_evidence: resolved Web V2 dist path and index existence
missing local asset references from built index
existing service logs and PID/port facts
g3.recovery_or_reason: If the artifact is absent or partial, fail before stopping the current Web and provide an explicit build instruction. If the backend starts but /ui/v2 is unavailable, return restart failure and preserve logs/receipt so the operator/model can explicitly build, reuse a proven equivalent artifact, or roll back.

g4.rollback: Revert the narrow restart-hardening commit. The change has no durable schema/data migration and does not alter provider, Feishu, LFRT, or 8901/model state.
